kind: Frozen real-data demonstration; browser controls inspect precomputed analyses, not a live NASA query

PRECTOTCORR.name: Precipitation
PRECTOTCORR.aggregation: annual total from monthly mean daily rates

method.estimator: ordinary least squares on complete annual values
method.uncertainty: Newey–West HAC, Bartlett kernel, lag 3, n/(n−2) correction; Student t reference with n−2 degrees of freedom
method.multiplicity: Holm family-wise adjustment across all 36 fixed demo tests: 6 coordinates × 2 variables × 3 time windows; invalid tests enter as p=1.
method.sensitivity: Unadjusted slope confidence intervals and p-values also reported at HAC lags 1 and 5
method.interpretation: Exploratory, model-conditional evidence. Repeated exploration of different date windows is not covered by this correction. Statistical significance is not practical importance or causation.

source.name: NASA POWER / MERRA-2 reanalysis
source.meaning: NASA model/reanalysis values for the grid cell selected by each coordinate; not station measurements or a city-wide average
source.si_disclosure: OpenAI Codex assisted acquisition/analysis code and documentation. Original NASA data values are retained unchanged.
